topography.project_purpose: Liquidity Manager. Structurally: 24 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 4 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 7 functional families. Its contracts share 2 common project-authored base contract(s) (ichivaultdepositguard, aegisvaultcore). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
